summary: Iter-221 BNPL Settlements Registration page — full E2E validated. 8/8 iter220 unit tests pass, 6/6 new HTTP integration tests (test_bnpl_register_iter221_e2e.py) pass, and Playwright UI run on the real preview URL confirms the entire flow: page loads at /bnpl-settlements/register, sidebar link nav-bnpl-register present, both provider cards (tabby+tamara) render with 4 metrics + match-status pill + add-settlement button each, modal opens with all 8 fields, save creates a balanced 5-leg ledger entry, ledger-entry-modal displays with debits=credits=500/600 SAR, recent-row testid appears, idempotent re-submit shows Arabic info toast 'تم تسجيل هذه التسوية مسبقاً — لم يُنشأ قيد جديد.', and over-settlement is rejected with Arabic 400 error.

issues: After seeding 600 receivable, compute_all_settlements returns expected_total = -6.90 SAR (slight negative from refund/commission rounding in the existing summary engine). This causes the match-status pill to flash 'يحتاج مراجعة' (red) before any settlement is registered. Pre-existing behaviour of compute_all_settlements, not a regression in iter-221, but worth investigating: a 0 receivable + small negative expected probably should clamp to 0/green rather than red.

action_items: Optional: in compute_all_settlements or the overview endpoint, clamp expected_total ≥ 0 (or treat |expected|<0.5 as green) so a brand-new merchant with 0 settlements and a tiny refund-driven negative doesn't show 'يحتاج مراجعة' red.

BnplSettlementsRegister.jsx — modal 'modal-cancel' click target is also bound to backdrop click via onClick={onClose} on the root; works but could accidentally close on inner drag-release. Minor UX.
settlement_bridge.py:143 — the 'total - receivable > 0.01' guard uses absolute tolerance only; could allow a 1-cent over-settlement to slip through but acceptable given Arabic UX rounding.
